messages:
Sam Patel: Heads up: customer org-7432 reported tokens dropped to 0 during a large batch ingest around the monthly reset and got 429s for ~3m. UI showed refill at 00:00 UTC but API returned 429 until 00:03. Logs below and a quick curl that reproduces in our env. :thinking_face:

Sam Patel:
```
2024-11-03T00:00:00Z GET /v1/usage org=org-7432 status=429 req_id=rid-11
2024-11-03T00:00:01Z quota-service refill org=org-7432 +50000
2024-11-03T00:02:58Z GET /v1/usage org=org-7432 status=200 req_id=rid-19
```

Sam Patel: curl to repro (sanitized):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED" -d '{"input":"foo","max_tokens":64}'
```

Nina Gomez: can you paste the tenant id and a few request IDs and whether the client retried aggressively? Also which SDK/version?

Sam Patel: tenant=org-7432; req ids: `rid-11`,`rid-12`,`rid-13`,`rid-19`. Customer was running 25 parallel workers with exponential backoff but tail latency retries were heavy.

quota-bot: refill event processed for org-7432 at 00:00:01 UTC, +50000 tokens, source=monthly-rollover

Jordan Lee: any billing events or plan changes around reset? proration can cause short windows if we reconcile credit assignments late.

Sam Patel: no plan change; subscription active, no promo credit updates.

Priya Rao: sounds like edge cache/invalidation lag or the quota write didn't propagate to the edge nodes. Workaround: ask customer to wait 3-5m or rotate the API key (forces cache miss). For us: 1) trace request_ids through edge -> quota cache -> quota-service logs; 2) check cache invalidation events around 00:00; 3) look for reconcilers that apply refill events asynchronously. I'll kick off a trace for rid-11..rid-19.

Priya Rao: if we confirm edge TTL/replication lag, short-term mitigation is to make refill events synchronously invalidate relevant edge keys for high-throughput tenants.

Sam Patel: creating INC-2024-928 with logs and the customer's repro steps, will link here. @Priya can you escalate to eng-infra if traces show propagation >30s? :thumbsup:

Priya Rao: yup I'll take it if traces show >30s. Thanks — I'll post findings in INC-2024-928.
